instructions: Replace the entries 'epachayan-mackay-marshall', 'mackay-1938' and 'marshall-1931' in data/MANIFEST.json with the entries under 'changed', append the entry under 'new', and update 'counts' and 'updated' as given. All other fields follow the existing schema (schema_version 1).
counts_note: epachayan-mackay-marshall moves from not-held to held; mackay-1938 moves from not-held to partly-held (vol. I held, vol. II plates not held); marshall-1931 moves from held to partly-held (vols. I and II held, vol. III plates not held); one project output is added. Total 86 sources. These counts assume no other package changes the manifest in the same round.

changed.title: Koshy (epachayan/indus-script), machine-readable seal catalogues from Mackay (1938) and Marshall (1931)

version.zenodo_doi: 10.5281/zenodo.22852769 (concept DOI in README and CITATION.cff); version record 10.5281/zenodo.23281781 holds only a preprint PDF

identifiers: excavation field number (Mackay DK, SD, DK.H.; Marshall area and serial)
metadata_fields: block, house, room or street (Mackay); excavation area (Marshall)
level relative to the DK datum or SD bench mark (Mackay); depth below the modern surface (Marshall)

rights.licence: Transcribed tables CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA at the pin); code MIT (LICENSE; docs/DATA_NOTICE.md says MIT covers scripts/ only)
rights.detail: LICENSE-DATA covers transcriptions/mackay1938_seal_table/, transcriptions/marshall1931_seal_table/, transcriptions/mackay1938_plates/ and outputs/mackay_seal_table.csv, marshall_seal_table.csv, marshall_seal_table_transcribed.csv, findspots_mackay.csv, concordance_parpola_G.csv, concordance_m77_G_inferred.csv, constraints.csv. Required attribution: Nitin Stephen Koshy, "Indus script: seal catalogues and text-structure analysis" (2026), https://github.com/epachayan/indus-script. The tables were transcribed by an AI model; a 13 October check found 0 of 30 Mackay rows and 3 of 30 Marshall rows in error against the print.

changed.notes: Notice files are hashed as committed blobs because Git may convert their line endings on checkout; the four CSV files carry eol=lf and hash the same in any checkout. Use outputs/marshall_seal_table_transcribed.csv for Marshall; the repository marks outputs/marshall_seal_table.csv as a superseded OCR version. Known transcription errors against the print are listed in experiments/2026-10-13-mackay-marshall-tables/verification/print-corrections.csv. The clone may also be made with tools/fetch_data.py --fetch epachayan-mackay-marshall.

new.title: Join of the Mackay 1938 and Marshall 1931 seal-table rows to Lipi object families and CISI numbers

rights.detail: Join keys, dispositions, checks and counts are own work (CC0 per LICENSE). The table values in join-table.csv are from Koshy's transcription, CC BY 4.0, with the attribution in the package README. No Lipi field values are included.

new.notes: Join precision on a 30-join random sample: 29 correct, 0 wrong, 1 unresolved. Values keep the excavators' units (inches; feet against the stated datum).
